text: This report recommends that City Council approve the alterations proposed for the three heritage buildings at 239 Dundas Street East, 241-243 Dundas Street East, and 247-255 Dundas Street East (designated under Part V of the Ontario Heritage Act as part of the Garden District Heritage Conservation District) in connection with the development of the subject properties. The development application proposes a 52-storey tower (plus mechanical penthouse) on the site that incorporates retained portions of the heritage buildings as part of the base building, as well as the introduction of a new base building along Pembroke Street. The retained facades of the corner building 247-255 Dundas Street East are proposed to be relocated within the site, closer to the intersection of Dundas Street East and Pembroke Street.
